# Periodic checks

Background URL watching with three alert types (site down, page contains text, page changed), run every 15 minutes to 6 hours and notifying only when the state changes.

## [notify-on-transitions.md](notify-on-transitions.md): Notify on state changes only [implemented] (53 lines)

Checks store an alerting flag and notify only when the state flips, so a site that stays down produces one alert per outage rather than one per run.

Answers: Why do I only get one notification while a site is down?

## [behavior.md](behavior.md): Periodic check evaluation rules (59 lines)

ChecksWorker evaluates each enabled check via HTTP GET, strips script and style tags, hashes visible text with SHA-256, and uses the alerting flag to notify on transitions.
